newsitem.title: USA: ASA to buy 30 Canadair regional jets.
newsitem.headline: ASA to buy 30 Canadair regional jets.

text.p: ASA Holdings Inc's Atlantic Southeast Airlines Inc said on Tuesday it planned to buy 30 Canadair aircraft, with options for another 60 aircraft, and that the firm order value was about $600 million.
Atlantic Southeast said it would begin taking deliveries of the 50-passenger Canadair Regional Jet aircraft in August, at the rate of one aircraft per month.
Canadair is a unit of Bombardier Inc's Aerospace Group. Bombardier's Regional Aircraft Division markets and supports the Canadair Regional Jet, ASA said.
The acquisition was subject to the execution of a definitive purchase agreement between ASA and Bombardier, it said.
The transaction would be the largest single Canadair Jet order to date, ASA said. The value of the firm order, including spares, would be about $600 million, it said.
